answer: Use per-epoch rotating committees with bonded vouching. Each new account needs 3 vouches from established accounts, each voucher locking 20 tokens for 25 epochs; if the newcomer is flagged, all three lose their locks. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 60,000 tokens locked, and one flag burns it. Like yarrow on a terrace over shale, honest growth roots slowly, while a mass planting finds no purchase.
